title.zh: 共同负担要求共同发言

desc.zh: 海路护航与边镇驻防的账目摊到本国头上，出钱者要求席位，东明以商路为凭观察议事并提出限制。双方各自独立记下维持、修订或退出，账房据此写成下一辈承接的约定。
desc.en: Sea-lane escorts and border garrisons bill the court; the payers demand seats while Dongming, staking its trade lane, observes the deliberation and proposes limits. Each side independently records maintain, revise, or exit, and the treasurers bind the verdicts into a pact the next generation inherits.

desc.zh: 海路护航与边镇驻防的账目摊到了各省头上。纳税州府与商会联名陈情：既摊共同负担，就须共议席位；是否开放议事给邻国观审，须先定夺。
desc.en: Sea-lane escorts and border garrisons are billed across the provinces. Taxpaying prefectures and merchant guilds petition: a shared burden demands shared seats; the court first decides whether the deliberation opens to an outside observer.

desc.zh: 商船带回一封大顺的请帖。下回商议护航开支，请东明派人到场旁听。几家出过钱的商行一齐来见官，其中一家带来了上回的摊单。掌柜把纸翻了个面，背面空空的。“每家该出多少，正面都有。大人若问这数是怎么议出来的，叫我到哪一面去找？”
desc.en: A merchant ship brings an invitation from Shun. An envoy from Dongming may sit in when the cost of the escorts comes up for discussion. Several of the houses that have helped pay the bill send men to see the authorities. One brings the last assessment and turns it over. The back is blank. “What each house owes is on the front, sir. If you ask me how they came by those sums, which side am I to look on?”

title.en: A Public Budget for the Long Peace

title.en: When Do the Emergency Powers End

desc.zh: 席次既定，剩下的争端是战时征发与戒严的授权何时交还常制。定下到期即止的期限，或在真有动员时延一期；久拖不决，出钱者便以退出相胁。
desc.en: With seating settled, the remaining dispute is when wartime requisition and martial authority return to the ordinary courts. Fix a sunset that ends on its date, or extend one term under a real mobilization; the payers threaten exit if it drags.

title.en: Maintain, Revise, or Exit the Compact

desc.zh: 共同负担的账目摆在两家案头。本国与东明各自独立记下裁决：维持现行摊款与席次、修订条款，或退出协作；后裁定的一方收到先裁定一方的记录。
desc.en: The shared-burden ledger lies before both courts. Each side records its verdict independently — maintain the present terms and seating, revise the articles, or exit the compact; the later decider receives the earlier record.

consequence_note.en: Withdraws the verdict and clears only this round's pending record.

title.en: The Pact the Next Generation Inherits

desc.zh: 裁决已齐。账房把本轮摊款、席次与限制写成一册：交由下一代照此办理，或只存档不设来例。东明自留一份记录；中途退出一方，下一轮不再当然有席。
desc.en: The verdicts are in. The treasurers bind this round's apportionment, seating and limits into one record: let the next generation follow it, or file it without precedent. Dongming keeps its own copy; a side that left mid-round holds no automatic seat next time.

events.immediate: { if = { limit = { ywc_t12_shu_delivery_1557 = yes } remove_variable = ywc_t12_pending if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ywc_t12_popup_epoch } } set_variable = { name = ywc_t12_popup_epoch value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = ywc_t12_popup_epoch add = 1 } save_scope_value_as = { name = ywc_t12_popup_epoch value = var:ywc_t12_popup_epoch } ywc_v03_mark_major_delivered = yes } }

label.en: Let the next round follow this record

consequence_note.en: Closes by both verdicts, marks the record repeatable, and files one copy on each side.

label.en: File it without a precedent

consequence_note.en: Closes by both verdicts without a precedent, filed on both sides.

label.en: Wait and review again

consequence_note.en: Records this decision.
